items.text: Week 2 Injury Report beneficiaries: Ladd McConkey=Tre Harris; Ja'Kobi Lane=Rashod Bateman/Chris Moore; A.J. Brown=Romeo Doubs/DeMario Douglas; Alvin Kamara=Kendre Miller; Kyler Murray=Carson Wentz; Dylan Sampson=Raheim Sanders; Jordyn Tyson=Devaughn Vele.
items.why: Direct injury fallout mapping for available players.
items.opportunity: Immediate role expansion for listed beneficiaries if principals out.

items.text: Brock Bowers (left knee meniscus trim) has a legit chance to return Week 2 or 3 per coach, but same knee as prior PCL sprain/bone bruise last year makes it scary.
items.why: Kubiak day-to-day; Schefter realistic chance miss only one game after meniscus trim.
items.implication: Monitor practice; possible TE1 return vs LAC, else Mayer continues elevated.
items.opportunity: If out, Michael Mayer target share bump; reverse if unexpectedly active.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey dealing with rib injury, day-to-day per HC Jim Harbaugh; team wants to see how he feels this week before Week 2 vs Raiders availability.
items.why: Rib injury from Week 1 hit; Harbaugh/Rapoport confirm monitored, status up in air.
items.implication: GTD risk; if out, WR room thins significantly.
items.opportunity: Tre Harris elevated snaps/routes/targets as primary beneficiary.

items.text: Kenneth Walker III strong MNF love as full grown man/workhorse in Chiefs debut; FFHH MNF recap emphasizes elevated role post-trade.
items.why: Dominant usage and production in first game with KC.
items.implication: Must-start RB1; buy if available cheap.

items.text: Kenneth Walker true workhorse in KC debut: 29 of first 32 RB opportunities, 19 routes on 33 Mahomes dropbacks, tied team-high 6 targets (22% share); 23-173-1 rush + 3-18-1 rec.
items.why: Dominated opportunities/routes/targets as expected in new role.
items.implication: Elite RB1 weekly floor/ceiling with full workhorse role.
items.opportunity: High snap/route/goal-line share locked in; no committee threat.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty high-end RB1: 73% snaps, 70% rush attempts, 61% routes, 21% targets, 23-156 yds +2 TDs; Utilization Score 99 tying Bijan. Yards before/after contact improved.
items.why: Every-down dominance in new scheme/OL; historical comps elite.

items.text: Patriots WR A.J. Brown high ankle sprain, placed on IR, expected miss ~6 weeks; no surgery.
items.why: High ankle from Week 1; Rapoport/Schefter confirm multi-week absence.
items.implication: NE WR room opens for volume; stash handcuffs long-term.
items.opportunity: Romeo Doubs, DeMario Douglas, Mack Hollins target/role expansion.

items.text: Surprised Travis Etienne didn't dominate more with Alvin Kamara (knee) out: snaps 53 Etienne /26 Kendre Miller /15 Donaldson; routes 24/5/7; opportunities 18/9/4.
items.why: Committee persisted despite Kamara absence; low route share for lead back.
items.implication: Etienne low-end RB2; Kamara return further dilutes.
items.opportunity: Kendre Miller clear handcuff/beneficiary with standalone if Kamara limited.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers hamstring not considered serious; day-to-day, would have returned if playoff game; MRI pending but good sign from coach Jesse Minter.
items.why: Hamstring after 5-150-1; sources say not serious, abundance of caution.
items.implication: Likely plays or limited; monitor practice participation.
items.opportunity: If out, Bateman/Moore elevated; reverse if active.

items.text: Rashee Rice tiny career aDOT 4.9 (2.5 last night); needs serious volume. Only 2 targets (7% share) but routes solid: 29 on 33 Mahomes dropbacks (behind only Worthy 30).
items.why: Low aDOT/target share despite high route participation.
items.implication: Volume-dependent; efficiency risk if targets stay low.
items.opportunity: Routes confirm role; upside if target share rises with Mahomes.

items.text: Quinshon Judkins only 13 routes on 30 Watson dropbacks even after Dylan Sampson (knee) exited early; Browns used third-stringer Raheim Sanders for 13 routes.
items.why: Low pass-game involvement despite backfield injury.
items.implication: Limited receiving upside; more pure rusher profile.
items.opportunity: Sanders handcuff if Judkins/Sampson issues persist.

items.text: Lions RB Isiah Pacheco surgery to remove body pressing nerve in back; 12-week recovery, chance back early December. Originally MCL then back while training.
items.implication: DET RB depth thins; Gibbs/Monty full control.
items.opportunity: Jahmyr Gibbs sole lead; any handcuff elevated.

items.text: Panthers RB usage: Chuba Hubbard 48 snaps/25 routes/13 opps vs Jonathon Brooks 13/5/6. Brooks worked off to side early last week (groin tweak alleged).
items.why: Hubbard clear lead; Brooks limited possibly by minor injury.
items.implication: Hubbard secure RB2; Brooks stash if healthy expands.
items.opportunity: Brooks handcuff value if Hubbard misses.

items.text: Josh Downs stayed on for 2-WR sets: 32 routes on 34 Daniel Jones dropbacks. Confirms slot role stickiness.
items.why: High route rate even in reduced personnel.
items.implication: Reliable target earner in IND offense.
items.opportunity: Elevated route share in all sets.
